messages:
Maya F.: FYI — EdgeHealth autopay failed on INV-8421. Customer says their corporate card has a per-transaction limit of $5k but invoice is $18k, gateway returned card_declined. Need ops/finance plan for next steps.
Sam P.: Can you paste the gateway decline payload? we need the decline code & AVS/issuer notes to decide if retry makes sense.
Maya F.: Gateway payload (from billing-bot) is below — got it from the webhook:
billing-bot: {
  status: "failed",
  decline_code: "do_not_honor",
  auth_code: null,
  avs_result: "N",
  customer_id: "cust_8241"
}
Alex R.: On a call w/ Lina — they don't have ACH set up in our portal and procurement prefers to use their corporate card. They offered either: 1) split into 4 invoices to fit limit, 2) manual wire (they asked for instructions), or 3) temporary raise on card (unlikely).
Lina (EdgeHealth): Confirming — procurement can split payment across 4 card transactions if you can send split invoices. Wire is OK but needs bank instructions + remittance info. Need ETA today.
Sam P.: OK. Ops options: a) generate 4 partial invoices (INV-8421-1..4) with amounts ~4500 each and enable individual autopay attempts; b) send a manual pay link for the full invoice for them to pay once; c) provide wire instructions. I prefer (a) to preserve autopay flow. Thoughts?
Maya F.: Finance: splitting is fine but we need to ensure revenue recognition and reconciliation stays clear. Alex, will CS accept 4 PO lines?
Alex R.: Procurement said PO covers the full amount but they'd rather we issue 4 invoices referencing the same PO number. They can map it on their side.
Maya F.: Cool. Sam, you have ops go-ahead to create split invoices and enable autopay retries? If so I'll flag for accounting to accept split for AR.
Sam P.: I'll create the partial invoices and wire a manual pay link as fallback. Generating now.
billing-bot: Created invoices: INV-8421-1, INV-8421-2, INV-8421-3, INV-8421-4. Payment links: https://billing.redwood.ai/inv/INV-8421-1/pay (and ...-2/...-3/...-4). Autopay scheduled to attempt each once immediately, then 24h and 72h.
Maya F.: Nice — please do 24h spacing between attempts per card token to avoid gateway rate limits. Also add note on the invoices: "Reference PO 5542-EH, customer requested split per transaction limit."
Sam P.: Done. Added note and adjusted retry spacing.
Alex R.: I'll notify Lina and confirm which route they pick. Lina — which do you prefer?
Lina (EdgeHealth): We'll try the 4-card approach first. If that fails we'll submit wire. Please send wire instructions in parallel just in case. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Maya F.: I'll post our wire instructions below for CS to forward. Bank: FirstBank NA, Account: 123456789, Routing: 021000021, Swift: FBNKUS33. Remit to: payments@redwood.ai and include INV-8421 and PO 5542-EH.
Sam P.: Logged action items: 1) ops created split invoices + pay links (done) 2) adjust retries spacing (done) 3) provide wire instructions (done in thread) 4) CS will confirm with customer (Alex). Closing once payment posts.
Alex R.: I'll update the ticket and ping when payment posted. Maya — do you want an accounting flag to mark as split and tie to original invoice?
Maya F.: Yes — please tag AR with "split-invoice" and original INV-8421 so month-end reconciliation knows these are one economic event.
Alex R.: Will do. Thanks everyone.
Lina (EdgeHealth): Thanks y'all — sending cards now.
